cambridge-21-reading-3.ex: Inequality, authoritarianism and patriarchy aren't inevitable.

cambridge-21-reading-3.def: certain to happen and impossible to avoid or prevent
cambridge-21-reading-3.ex: Inequality, authoritarianism and patriarchy aren't inevitable. They're choices.

cambridge-21-reading-3.def: used to compare or contrast two things — 'rather than', 'in contrast to'
senses: opposed to = against something (opposed to a plan)
cambridge-21-reading-3.ex: how old our species is — about 300,000 years old as opposed to 200,000.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: producing very clear, strong and detailed pictures in the mind
senses: (of colour) very bright and strong
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Most dream states, and certainly those with the most vivid dreams, happen during REM sleep.

mnem.story: Yangi Vivo telefonimning ekrani shu qadar yorqin (vivid) tasvir chiqaradiki, tushlarim ham aniq-tiniq bo'lib qoldi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: having the power to affect or change the way people think or act
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: David Scheel's documentary was influential on other research into the sleeping patterns of octopuses.

mnem.story: Instagramdagi influencer shunchalik ta'sirli (nufuzli) bo'ldiki, bitta so'zi bilan millionlarning fikrini o'zgartirdi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: the regular way in which a person or animal sleeps (times, stages and habits)
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: David Scheel's documentary was influential on other research into the sleeping patterns of octopuses.

mnem.story: Har kechasi patnisda ovqat yeb uxlaganim uchun uyqu tartibim (sleep pattern) butunlay buzilib ketdi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: a small metal part that carries electricity into or out of the body to measure or send signals
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Studies using electrodes attached to the heads of sleepers have shown that when we sleep, we do so in two ways that alternate throughout the night.

mnem.story: Doktor boshimga elektr simli elektrodlarni ulab, miyamdagi tokni o'lchay boshladi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: the piece of skin that can close over the front of each eye
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: During this stage our eyes move, even though our eyelids are closed.

mnem.story: Ko'zimning qopqog'i (lid) shu qadar og'irlashdiki, ko'z qovog'im o'z-o'zidan yopilib ketdi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: despite the fact that; used to introduce a surprising or contrasting fact
senses: (adverb, at end) however: 'It's hard. I'll try, though.'
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: During this stage our eyes move, even though our eyelids are closed.

mnem.story: Ishlar juda qiyin bo'lsa ham (though), men baribir zo'r natija ko'rsatdim.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to make a sudden small movement with a part of the body, often without meaning to
senses: (noun) a sudden small uncontrolled movement
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Our muscles also twitch slightly, though they are largely paralysed so we don't hurt ourselves.

mnem.story: Twitch'da qo'rqinchli o'yin ko'rayotib, hayajondan qo'llarim beixtiyor uchib-uchib qo'ydi (twitch).

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to make a person or body part unable to move
senses: to make something unable to work or act: 'The strike paralysed the city.'
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Our muscles also twitch slightly, though they are largely paralysed so we don't hurt ourselves.

mnem.story: Yutuqdan bir qop para (pul) olgan odam hayajondan falaj bo'lib (paralysed), joyidan qimirlolmay qoldi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: used to show that the next thing is very different from what was just mentioned
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: In contrast, we also engage in non-REM sleep, during which we barely move at all.

mnem.story: Telefon ekranidagi kontrastni ko'targanimda, oq va qora aksincha (in contrast) bo'lib ajralib ko'rindi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: a complicated system of paths, used in experiments to test how animals find their way
senses: a confusing set of rules or information: 'a maze of regulations'
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Researchers compared the brain patterns of rats running through a maze when awake with their brain patterns during REM sleep.

mnem.story: Labirint (maze) ichida adashib qolmaslik uchun yerga mayizlarni terib ketyapman.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: very interesting because it is unusual or not fully explained
senses: (intriguingly, adverb) in a way that makes you curious
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: The nightmare study is intriguing, says Scheel, but is only based on one animal.

mnem.story: Serialning intrigasi shu qadar qiziqarli (intriguing) ediki, tong otguncha uxlay olmadim.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: existing everywhere or shared by everyone in a group
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: That said, dreaming and REM sleep are unlikely to be universal in the animal kingdom.

mnem.story: Universal Studios kinolarini butun dunyoda, hamma joyda ko'rishadi — bu umumiy (universal) qiziqish.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: a very simple sea animal with a soft body full of holes and no brain
senses: a soft material full of holes used for washing
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: For example, sponges don't have brains, so they lack the machinery for dreaming.

mnem.story: SpongeBob aslida miyasi yo'q oddiy dengiz gubkasi (sponge), shuning uchun u tush ham ko'ra olmaydi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: here: the internal parts or system that make something work (the brain 'machinery')
senses: machines as a group: 'farm machinery'
the organised system that runs something: 'the machinery of government'
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: For example, sponges don't have brains, so they lack the machinery for dreaming.

mnem.story: Zavoddagi eski mashina-uskunalar (machinery) issiqdan erib, mashina eriyapti.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: 'it's thought that…' = many people believe/consider that…
senses: (noun) an idea or opinion: 'a sudden thought'
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: It's thought that they don't experience REM sleep because during REM sleep animals are more vulnerable to extremes of temperature.

mnem.story: Hamma bu tortni eng mazali deb hisoblaydi (it's thought that), lekin aslida hech kim tatib ko'rmagan.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to a medium degree; neither very much nor very little
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: As soon as animals evolved moderately complex lifestyles, they would have needed to dream in order to manage these lifestyles.

mnem.story: Bu model o'rtacha (moderately) chiroyli — na juda go'zal, na xunuk, o'rtachadan.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: relating to how things seem or appear on the outside, not the inner experience
senses: (adverb, outwards) towards the outside
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: However, we still don't understand how this outward behaviour relates to internal experience.

mnem.story: Uyning tashqi (outward) ko'rinishi juda hashamatli, lekin ichkarisi butunlay bo'sh ekan.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: the imagined scene or world that appears in a dream
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: It seems impossible to know what it is like to be a rat or a pigeon, let alone imagine their dreamscapes.

mnem.story: Har kechasi tushimdagi go'zal manzaraga (dreamscape) qochib (escape), zerikarli hayotdan uzoqlashaman.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to decide what something means or what has caused it
senses: to translate speech from one language to another
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: We are quick to interpret the twitching limbs and quiet barks of sleeping dogs.

mnem.story: Internet o'chib qolsa, chet ellikning gapini qanday tarjima qilishni (interpret) bilmay qolaman.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: an arm or a leg of a person or animal (of an octopus, one of its arms)
senses: a large branch of a tree
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: We are quick to interpret the twitching limbs and quiet barks of sleeping dogs.

mnem.story: Sakkizoyoq har bir a'zosi (limb) bilan bittadan limonni mahkam ushlab oldi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to follow or chase someone or something in order to catch it
senses: to continue with a plan or activity: 'pursue a career'
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Her limbs and head moved, and her skin rapidly changed colour, as though she was pursuing a crab.

mnem.story: Van Persie to'pni maqsad sari quvib (pursue), darvoza tomon shiddat bilan yugurdi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to move the body or limbs violently and without control
senses: to defeat someone easily in a game or contest
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Costello, as the octopus was called, thrashed around, extended his mantle as if trying to make himself look bigger, and squirted ink.

mnem.story: Ko'chaga axlat (trash) sochgan bezorini tutib olib, yaxshilab kaltaklashdi (thrashed).

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: the soft muscular body part of an octopus or squid behind the head
senses: a role or responsibility passed on: 'take on the mantle of leader'
the hot layer of the Earth below the crust
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Costello ... extended his mantle as if trying to make himself look bigger, and squirted ink.

mnem.story: Sakkizoyoq o'z tanasini (mantle) shishirib, xuddi kattakon bir mantidek ko'rinib ketdi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to force liquid out quickly through a narrow opening
senses: (noun) a thin fast stream of liquid
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Costello ... squirted ink as though he were being attacked by a predator.

mnem.story: Squirtle degan Pokemon dushmaniga suvni kuch bilan purkab (squirt) yubordi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: a set of related events or actions that follow each other in a particular order
senses: (verb) to arrange things in an order
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

mnem.story: Soatdagi sekundlar bir-birining ketidan ketma-ketlikda (sequence) tinmay o'tib turadi.

cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.def: to make something easier to understand by giving new information
cambridge-21-reading-2-p1.ex: Better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

mnem.story: Qorong'i xonada LED chiroqni yoqib, sirli masalani oydinlashtirdim (shed light on).
